Interview Questions for 3.1 What is semantic HTML? Semantic HTML uses elements whose names describe the meaning/purpose of their content. section vs article? section groups related content around a topic. article represents an independent/self-contained piece of content. aside? Supporting or secondary content related to the surrounding/main content. div vs semantic element? div is a generic container with no semantic meaning. Semantic elements communicate the purpose of their content. Should we completely avoid div? No. Use semantic elements where they correctly represent the content and div when a generic grouping/container is appropriate. Your Quick Revision HTML = PAGE STRUCTURE HEADER → Intro/header content NAV → Navigation MAIN → Main page content SECTION → GROUP / TOPIC ARTICLE → ONE INDEPENDENT ITEM ASIDE → SUPPORTING CONTENT FOOTER → Footer information DIV → Generic block container SPAN → Generic inline container
